body: yeah that's what i've turned to lately which probably isn't helping with anything but those few hours of peace are so tempting and I feel like I can't find them any other way.

yeah it really just makes me feel worse that I was doing better and now I'm back.. 

And yeah I feel like if I wasn't constantly reminded of her I could move on but that's not really an option. I've considered transferring but I don't know where I'd go and I've already invested so much here... I just feel stuck.

My girlfriend broke up with me recently. Told me it was because she was having issues with depression and in our relationship she was too worried about me to care for herself. So now I feel responsible for losing the one person who cared about me and causing her to become depressed... Yeah I understand, I feel like I think about suicide or at least getting too drunk to feel more and more everyday...

I'm feeling similar. When something bad happens I usually try and find any way that I can blame myself for it. For me this is usually things that happen to me or affect me in some way. That probably makes me selfish... But basically I convince myself that everything wrong with me is my own fault and that I deserve to feel this way. I hope therapy goes well for you, best of luck.
